title: Review the recent changes in crates/ui/aura-ui-terminal that add Kitty terminal-graphics-protocol image rendering (new …
summary: Now let me run the build gates.I don't think this is ready to merge. All the gates pass, but the escape strings are only checked byte-for-byte; nothing tests what a real Kitty terminal does with them, and that's where it breaks. The most serious bug is that moving an image (on every scroll) leaves a copy behind at the old spot.
